title: FinOps FOCUS Cost Model Input (v1.4)
description: Input schema derived from the FinOps Foundation FOCUS specification v1.4. See https://focus.finops.org/docs/specification/v1-4/

BillingCurrency.description: Currency code for billing (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, DKK

BilledCost.description: The cost that was billed, in the billing currency

EffectiveCost.description: The amortized/normalized cost after discounts and commitments

ListCost.description: The list price cost before any discounts

NegotiatedCost.description: The cost after negotiated discounts, before commitments

ServiceName.description: The name of the cloud service, e.g. 'AWS EC2', 'Azure Virtual Machines'

ServiceCategory.description: The category of the service, e.g. 'Compute', 'Storage', 'Network'

ServiceProvider.description: Identifier for the cloud provider, e.g. 'AWS', 'Azure', 'GCP'

ServiceProviderName.description: Display name of the cloud provider

ResourceName.description: The name of the individual resource

InvoiceId.description: Identifier of the invoice this charge belongs to

InvoiceIssuer.description: Name of the entity issuing the invoice

PricingUnit.description: The unit used for pricing, e.g. 'hours', 'GB-month'

CommitmentDiscountId.description: Identifier for the commitment discount (RI/Savings Plan)

CommitmentDiscountType.description: Type of commitment, e.g. 'Reserved Instance', 'Savings Plan'

Tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the resource

Labels.description: Key-value labels applied to the resource
